MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor VELCRO tape fits my recent interest in mounting and fastening because it offers a plausible way to attach lightweight accessories without adding screws.",
    "Weather resistance feels relevant alongside my recent outdoor deck screws, although the VELCRO tape is the only item here I would choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts and metal-cutting wheels relate broadly to construction, but my recent needs involve nails, wood screws, and wall anchors; I have no current bolt-fastening or metal-cutting task.",
    "The caliper, thermometer, electronic cleaner, and lift sling solve specific problems that my recent purchases do not suggest I have.",
    "Eighteen rolls of duct tape and twelve wastebaskets exceed my immediate needs, while baby wipes have no clear connection to what I am doing."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat buying construction fasteners as a reason to want a broad range of tools and workshop supplies.",
    "My purchases of large packs of nails and screws seem to have been extended to bulk quantities of unrelated supplies, even though quantity only makes sense for something I need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The intended task matters: mounting objects and fastening wood are more relevant to me now than precision measurement, metalwork, or heavy lifting.",
    "Fastener dimensions, material, and tool compatibility matter more than simply being another piece of hardware.",
    "My vacuum bags were a specific replacement purchase; they do not imply a general need for cleaning products or household supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my mounting needs but stretched them into a much broader interest in tools and bulk supplies than my current tasks support."
}
